startup.title: Starting Viola
startup.timeout: Viola is still starting. Keep this window open. If this lasts over a minute, restart Viola.

welcome.title: Thank you for trying Viola
welcome.speech: Thank you so much for trying Viola. We are still in beta, so a few things may be rough around the edges. If anything breaks, please tell us. It genuinely helps. Let me walk you through a short setup, and then you are on your way.

account_pair.title: Connect account
account_pair.speech: First, connect this app to your Viola account. Open account settings to sign in or create your account. I will continue automatically once you are signed in.

cloud_consent.title: Choose AI processing
cloud_consent.speech: To answer with Viola-managed AI, I need your permission to send request text and conversation context to cloud AI.

autonomy_tier.title: How much can Viola do?
autonomy_tier.speech: Choose how much Viola is allowed to do on this computer. You can change this any time in Settings.

mic_try.title: Say hello to Viola
mic_try.speech: Last step: hold the microphone button and ask Viola something, like what is two plus two. That checks your mic and runs your first command.

hear_about.title: How did you hear about Viola?
hear_about.speech: One quick, optional question: how did you hear about Viola? Pick an answer, or choose prefer not to say.

welcome.beta_note: You are one of Viola's first users. Thank you for being here.
welcome.report_hint: Found something broken? You can report a bug any time from the top bar.

account_pair.instructions: Open Account settings to sign in or create your Viola account. Setup continues automatically once you are signed in.
account_pair.signed_in_tts: Signed in. Let us finish setting up.
account_pair.no_account_hint: An account is only needed for Viola-managed AI. Without one, you can still run Viola on your own AI key or a local model.
account_pair.no_account_tts: No problem. You can run Viola on your own AI key or a local model instead. Let us finish setting up.

mic.unknown: Microphone access could not be confirmed.
mic.success_tts: Got it. I heard: {{heardText}}. Push-to-talk works.
mic.retry_tts: I did not catch that. Hold the microphone button, say one short phrase, then release.

cloud.settings_needed: Viola is set to use your own AI key. Add a provider key in AI settings, then return here.
cloud.managed_notice: Enable this only if you want Viola-managed AI to process your request text and conversation context.
cloud.enabled_tts: Cloud AI is enabled. Now try your first command.
cloud.declined_tts: Okay. Viola is set to use your own AI key. Open AI settings, add your provider key, then return here.
cloud.byok_ready_tts: Got it. Try your first command with your own AI key.
cloud.save_error: Couldn't save that AI setting. Try again.
cloud.no_account_notice: You are continuing without a Viola account, so Viola-managed AI is not available. Run Viola on your own provider key or a local model instead.

mic_try.error_tts: That command did not finish. Check your AI setup and try again.

attribution.optional_note: Totally optional, and it is the only marketing question Viola will ever ask. Your answer is stored as a single word on this computer.
attribution.group_label: How did you hear about Viola?

autonomy.note: This sets how much Viola may do on your behalf. Every option still asks before anything that changes your data.
autonomy.change_later: You can change this any time in Settings, under AI & Agents.
autonomy.save_error: Couldn't save that choice. Try again.

solo.label: Solo
solo.subtitle: Private & safe
solo.description: Answers questions, plays music, and searches the web. No file access, email, browsing, or desktop control.

ensemble.label: Ensemble
ensemble.subtitle: Capable & sandboxed
ensemble.description: Can read your files, browse the web in a sandbox, read email, and manage your calendar. Anything that changes data asks you first.

symphony.label: Symphony
symphony.subtitle: Full autonomy
symphony.description: Full access: write files, send email, control your desktop, and browse with saved passwords. Dangerous actions still ask first.

spoke_chat.open: Type a command for this room
spoke_chat.error: I could not send that command from this room. Check that the hub is online, then try again.
